verdict.rationale: An accounting SaaS with a public API could reasonably publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so the axis applies. Direct probes returned HTTP 404 for both https://www.freshbooks.com/llms.txt and the markdown docs variant (/api/start.md). The existing human-oriented REST API docs, Postman collection and SDK are standard developer documentation, not agent-oriented docs, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
